caption:
Got a text about a missing package? Check for these red flags: 📦
1. Urgency ("pay now or it's returned")
2. A link you didn't expect
3. A request for card details or a small fee

Don't tap. Open the courier's official app or site yourself.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#cybersecurity #scamalert #smishing #onlinesafety #phishing #staysafeonline #scams #techtips #privacy #techmendly

scenes.title: Be suspicious if it
items: Has a link you didn't expect
Asks for card details or a fee
scenes.say: Be suspicious if it creates a false hurry, has a link you did not expect, or asks for card details or a small fee.

scenes.myth: If it knows my name, it must be real.
scenes.fact: Scammers can buy or guess basic details. A name proves nothing.
scenes.say: If it knows your name, it must be real? No. Scammers can buy or guess basic details.

scenes.title: Skip the link. Check the courier's app
scenes.body: Or type the courier's address yourself.
scenes.say: Skip the link. Open the courier's official app, or type their website address yourself.

scenes.title: Delete it and report it
scenes.body: Use your phone's report spam option.
scenes.say: Then delete the message, and report it as spam on your phone.
